world.title: New Evooo1Bot Linux botnet turns routers into traffic relay nodes
world.summary: A new Mirai-based modular Linux botnet malware called Evooo1Bot has been targeting internet-facing gateway devices, turning them into SOCKS5 traffic relay nodes. [...]
